title: JEDI: JEPA-to-Edge Distillation for Efficient Cropland Segmentation from Satellite Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2609.07915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision models provide useful representations for remote-sensing segmentation but are often too expensive for deployment at the satellite or field edge. Existing feature-level distillation methods also tend to assume similar teacher and student architectures and often stop feature alignment when task training begins. We introduce JEDI (JEPA-to-Edge Distillation), a two-stage framework that transfers representations from a large I-JEPA Vision Transformer teacher to a compact SegFormer student. First, JEDI aligns the student's terminal representation with the teacher's token space using cross-architecture projection and spatial alignment. It then jointly optimizes supervised segmentation, temperature-scaled response distillation, and persistent feature alignment throughout task adaptation. On CalCROP21, JEDI-B0 achieves 68.0 mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) with 4.04M parameters, improving over the standalone student by 16.0 poin

translated_title: JEDI：面向边缘高效的卫星影像农田分割的JEPA到边缘蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 大型视觉模型为遥感分割提供了有用的表征，但对于在卫星端或田间边缘部署而言往往成本过高。现有的特征级蒸馏方法通常假设教师与学生架构相似，并且往往在任务训练开始时就停止特征对齐。我们提出了JEDI（JEPA到边缘蒸馏），这是一个两阶段框架，将表征从大型I-JEPA Vision Transformer教师模型迁移到紧凑的SegFormer学生模型。首先，JEDI使用跨架构投影和空间对齐，将学生的终端表征与教师的token空间对齐。随后，在整个任务适应过程中，它联合优化监督分割、温度缩放的响应蒸馏以及持续的特征对齐。在CalCROP21数据集上，JEDI-B0以仅4.04M参数实现了68.0的平均交并比（mIoU），比独立的学生模型提升了16.0个百分点。
tldr: JEDI提出了一种两阶段蒸馏框架，通过跨架构投影对齐与任务训练全程持续的特征蒸馏，将大型I-JEPA教师模型的知识迁移到轻量级SegFormer学生模型，仅用4.04M参数即可实现68.0 mIoU的高效卫星影像农田分割。
en_tdlr: JEDI is a two-stage distillation framework that transfers representations from a large I-JEPA ViT teacher to a compact SegFormer student via cross-architecture projection and persistent feature alignment throughout task adaptation, achieving efficient cropland segmentation with 68.0 mIoU using only 4.04M parameters.
